en.q: The input signal given to a CE amplifier having a voltage gain of 150 is V<sub>i</sub> = 2 cos(15t + π/3). The corresponding output signal will be :
en.sol:
A CE amplifier multiplies the amplitude by the gain and reverses the phase (adds π): output = 150 × 2 cos(15t + π/3 + π) = 300 cos(15t + 4π/3).

(Transistor amplifiers are no longer in the NEET syllabus.)

en.q: A npn transistor is connected in common emitter configuration in a given amplifier. A load resistance of 800 Ω is connected in the collector circuit and the voltage drop across it is 0.8 V. If the current amplification factor is 0.96 and the input resistance of the circuit is 192 Ω, the voltage gain and the power gain of the amplifier will respectively be:
en.sol:
Voltage gain Av = β × RL/Ri = 0.96 × 800/192 = 4. Power gain = β × Av = 0.96 × 4 = 3.84.

Answer: 4, 3.84. (Transistor amplifiers are no longer in the NEET syllabus.)
en.hint: A<sub>v</sub> = β R<sub>L</sub>/R<sub>i</sub>; power gain = β A<sub>v</sub>.

en.q: To get output 1 for the following circuit, the correct choice for the input is:
en.sol:
In the paper's circuit A and B go to an OR gate, whose output goes with C to an AND gate: Y = (A + B)·C.

Y = 1 needs C = 1 and at least one of A, B = 1. Only A = 1, B = 0, C = 1 does this.
en.hint: Any input set with C = 0 gives Y = 0.

hi.q: निम्नलिखित परिपथ के लिए निर्गत 1 प्राप्त करने हेतु निवेश का सही विकल्प है :

प्रश्नपत्र के परिपथ में A और B एक OR गेट में जाते हैं, जिसका निर्गत C के साथ एक AND गेट में जाता है : Y = (A + B)·C।

en.q: What is the output Y in the following circuit, when all the three inputs A, B, C are first 0 and then 1?
en.sol:
In the paper's circuit gate P is an AND gate on A, B and gate Q is a NOR gate on P and C: Y = (A·B + C)‾.

All inputs 0: P = 0, Y = (0 + 0)‾ = 1. All inputs 1: P = 1, Y = (1 + 1)‾ = 0. Answer: 1, 0.
en.hint: Work out P first, then Y.

hi.q: निम्नलिखित परिपथ में निर्गत Y क्या है, जब तीनों निवेश A, B, C पहले 0 और फिर 1 हैं?
hi.sol:
प्रश्नपत्र के परिपथ में गेट P, A, B पर एक AND गेट है और गेट Q, P और C पर एक NOR गेट है : Y = (A·B + C)‾।

सभी निवेश 0 : P = 0, Y = (0 + 0)‾ = 1। सभी निवेश 1 : P = 1, Y = (1 + 1)‾ = 0। उत्तर : 1, 0।

en.q: In a p-n junction diode, change in temperature due to heating :
o: does not affect resistance of p-n junction
affects the overall V – I characteristics of p-n junction
en.sol: Heating creates more electron–hole pairs: reverse saturation current rises, the barrier potential falls and forward current rises for a given voltage. Both forward and reverse behaviour change: it affects the overall V – I characteristics.
en.hint: Temperature changes the number of minority carriers and the barrier.
